Hi Sohana —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us over the last month. The OrbitCloud team was fantastic to work with and we wanted to ask for a small favor: would you be open to posting a short candid review on G2 about your experience? Even a couple sentences about the deployment speed and latency improvements would be super helpful for other teams evaluating Redwood.

To say thanks, we’d like to send a $150 digital gift (your choice: Amazon or Visa e-gift). If you’re comfortable, reply with the name/email you’d like the e-gift sent to, or tell me if procurement needs to handle it and we’ll route differently.

I attached a 1-page note with suggested bullets (feel free to ignore) and the direct G2 link to make it quick. If it helps, we’re also happy to provide a 30-second quote you can paste.

Would Friday work to post? No pressure — any timing that’s convenient.

Appreciate it,
Jonas
